title: Officer Avila is back! The Blue Notebook Review
description:
In this week's edition of the Blue Notebook Review, Sergeant Verbeck and the Neighborhood Resource Officers (NROs) provide a comprehensive update on public safety and community initiatives across Santa Monica.

In this episode, we cover:
Homelessness Outreach: Officer Tago discusses recent statistics and a successful relocation story involving a mother and daughter. 

Crime Suppression: Officer Hollowell reports on recent arrests and reminds residents to use the non-emergency line: 310-458-8491.

Traffic Safety: Officer Pardo highlights enforcement in school zones and high-collision corridors.

Community Engagement: Officer Avila previews upcoming neighborhood meetings and our "Compression with a Cop" event on March 12th!


Video Chapters
[00:00:01] – Introduction with Sergeant Verbeck
[00:00:15] – Homelessness Outreach update and relocation success story (Officer Tago)
[00:01:10] – Crime Suppression and non-emergency reporting (Officer Hollowell)
[00:02:18] – Traffic Safety: Enforcement in school zones and collision corridors (Officer Pardo)
[00:03:30] – Community Engagement: Upcoming meetings and "Compression with a Cop" (Officer Avila)
[00:04:45] – Closing remarks and how to stay connected
